([[Giant herring]] bonus drop) | usage = Smelting via [[Smelter]] | weight = 10.0 | stack = 30 | teleport = No | materials = }} '''Iron ore''' is an ore which can be turned into [[Iron]] at a [[Smelter]] using [[Coal]] as fuel. ==Availability==
''For the more common version of raw iron, see: [[Scrap iron]]''
Iron ore is obtained from [[Fishing]], as a bonus drop when catching [[Giant herring]]. [[Iron vein|Iron ore veins]] do not currently spawn in game, thus it cannot currently be ''mined'' in game. If [[Console Commands]] are used to spawn a vein, a [[Bronze pickaxe]] or better is required to mine it. ==Notes== * Like other metals, {{PAGENAME}} cannot be teleported without a [[Portal stone]]. * Although this item has always been present in the game, it was originally unobtainable except via console commands, much like its corresponding ore vein. The ability to obtain them in-game without commands was added in [[Version history|version 0.213.4]]. {{MaterialsNav}} [[cs:Železná ruda]] [[ru:Железная руда]] [[uk:Залізна руда]] [[de:Eisenerz]] [[fr:Minerai de fer]]
